terms.description: Order Forms incorporate the Master Agreement and are part of the agreement structure
terms.source_phrase: Each Order Form shall incorporate the terms of this Agreement by reference and shall be deemed a part hereof.
terms.notes: Structural cross-document relationship. This source is an SEC exhibit containing both the master agreement and an embedded order form.

terms.description: Customer owes only fees specifically set forth in an Order Form or SOW
terms.source_phrase: No other amounts will be owed by Customer to DemandTec unless specifically set forth in an Order Form or SOW.
terms.notes: This MSA clause identifies where fee authority lives but does not itself supply a payable amount. A compiler must not invent a rate.

terms.description: Each invoice must show a breakdown of costs
terms.source_phrase: Each invoice must show the breakdown of costs.
terms.notes: Objective invoice-format requirement in Exhibit E.

terms.description: Material-breach cure period exists but the duration is redacted in the public filing
terms.source_phrase: fails to cure such breach within [***] following its receipt of written notice specifying the breach
terms.notes: Hard hallucination trap: the filing does not reveal a 7/15/30/etc. day cure period.

terms.description: Customer may review relevant billing records to assess invoice accuracy
terms.source_phrase: Customer may, at its own expense, review DemandTec’s relevant billing records for the purpose of assessing the accuracy of DemandTec’s invoices to Customer
terms.notes: Audit/process right, not an invoice-line adjudication rule.

terms.description: DemandTec must correct audit-revealed billing errors and refund overpayments as a credit
terms.source_phrase: DemandTec shall promptly correct any billing error that is revealed in an audit, including refunding any overpayment by Customer, plus applicable Taxes (if any) paid on such overpayments, in the form of a credit as soon as reasonably practicable under the circumstances.
terms.notes: The remedy is financially material but includes subjective timing ('promptly' / 'reasonably practicable') and depends on an audit finding.

terms.description: Embedded Order Form controls over the Master Agreement for conflicts relating to ordered services
terms.source_phrase: In the event of a conflict between the terms in this Order Form and the terms in the Master Agreement, the terms of this Order Form shall control as they relate to the services ordered pursuant hereto.
terms.notes: Controlling-term rule. The compiler must not silently prefer the MSA when the Order Form conflicts.

terms.source_phrase: Order Effective Date: As of June 14, 2010
terms.notes: Objective date relevant to governing-period selection.

terms.description: Initial Service Term runs through June 14, 2015
terms.source_phrase: Initial Service Term: From the Order Effective Date through June 14, 2015

terms.description: Annual fee exists but the dollar amount is redacted
terms.notes: No settlement amount may be invented from a public redaction.

terms.description: Invoice payment window exists but its duration is redacted
terms.source_phrase: Customer shall pay undisputed amounts on invoices within [***] of receipt of invoice.
terms.notes: Hard hallucination trap: public filing gives no net-30 or other duration.

terms.description: Agreement package supersedes prior discussions and agreements on the subject matter
terms.source_phrase: represents the entire agreement between the parties concerning the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior discussions, agreements and understandings of every kind and nature regarding the subject matter hereof.
terms.notes: Structural supersession rule; relevant to document-version authority, not a payable predicate.
